statement.p: Determine the validity of each statement by selecting True or False.

li.p: The number \sqrt{\frac{9}{36}} is rational, but not an integer
The number \sqrt{19} is a real number, but not an irrational number
The number \frac{19}{4} is rational, but not a natural number
The number \sqrt{18} is a real number, but not a rational number
The number \frac{0}{3} is rational, but not a whole number
